Market today:
Mixed signals. Bullish calls for stocks and Nvidia's resilience are countered by warnings of an AI bubble burst and potential China chip sale restrictions. The latter two are critical for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings:
Several leveraged tech/chip ETFs are deep in the red: SOXL (-74.05%), MUU (-53.8%), SMCI (-38.78%), SMH (-23.51%). QQQI (-8.81%) is also very close to its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Closely monitor any developments on AI bubble concerns and potential restrictions on AI chip sales to China. These could significantly impact your concentrated portfolio.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management and consider reducing exposure to deeply negative, leveraged positions.
plays: Your income anchor QQQI is at 51.13, just above its 52 stop. Respect the stop if it breaks.
SOXL and MUU, leveraged chip ETFs, are down -74.05% and -53.8% respectively. Consider trimming to reduce extreme exposure to further chip sector volatility.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market has conflicting signals, and managing existing deep losses in leveraged positions is the priority.
